meta.title: Check a file · Chiibitsu Labs
meta.description: Check whether a file or hash is sealed in the public Aikiri ledger. Your file never leaves your device.

hero.sub: Drop a file or paste a hash. Your device works out the file's fingerprint, and the file is never uploaded. The page then looks for that fingerprint in the public ledger. A hash shows when a file was sealed and by whom, never who it is between. Only the original file shows that.

check.heading: Check
check.drop: Drop a file here, or choose one
check.dropNote: The file stays on your device. Files up to 250 MB.
check.hashPlaceholder: 64 characters, 0 to 9 and a to f
check.example: Try an example: the genesis block's hash
check.big: That file is over 250 MB. Work out its hash on your computer instead, then paste it here: on a Mac, shasum -a 256 file; on Windows, certutil -hashfile file SHA256.
check.bad: That is not a SHA-256 hash. It is 64 characters, using 0 to 9 and a to f.

how.heading: What a result means
items: A fingerprint (hash) is a short code worked out from a file. Change one byte of the file and the code changes completely.
Found means this exact file's fingerprint was sealed in a block, so the file existed in this exact form when the block was made. It does not say the file is good or true.

Private by default. A pasted hash or a link shows the issuer, the time and the ledger record. Dropping the original file also shows what it is and who it is between: your device sends the issuer a second fingerprint, never the file, and the issuer answers only if it matches the one stored when the file was sealed. A printed, scanned or re-saved copy has different bytes, so it shows nothing more.
Not found means no block holds it. The ledger holds only what Chiibitsu Labs has sealed, and a file that was edited after sealing will not match.

modal.privateNote: Who this is between stays private. Drop the original file to see it.
modal.revealNote: Shown because this is the original file. A copy shows nothing more.
modal.revealNone: The issuer has nothing more to show for this file.
modal.revealError: The issuer could not be asked just now. The ledger record above still stands.
